title: MCP Tools Contract for Todo AI Chatbot
description: JSON Schema definitions for all MCP server tools used by the AI chatbot agent

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Creates a new todo task for the authenticated user

user_id.description: ID of the authenticated user (from session context)

description.description: Optional detailed description of the task

success.description: Whether the task was created successfully

task_id.description: ID of the newly created task

message.example: I've added 'buy groceries' to your tasks!

errors.message: Title must be between 1 and 200 characters
Failed to create task. Please try again.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Retrieves all todo tasks for the authenticated user, optionally filtered by status

user_id.description: ID of the authenticated user (from session context)

status.description: Optional status filter: 'pending', 'completed', or null for all

tasks.description: List of tasks matching the filter, sorted by created_at DESC

errors.message: Failed to retrieve tasks. Please try again.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Marks a todo task as completed for the authenticated user

user_id.description: ID of the authenticated user (from session context)

task_id.description: ID of the task to mark as completed

success.description: Whether the task was completed successfully

message.example: Great! I've marked 'buy groceries' as completed.

errors.message: I couldn't find that task. Would you like to see your current tasks?
That task is already marked as complete!
You don't have permission to modify this task.
Failed to complete task. Please try again.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Permanently deletes a todo task for the authenticated user

user_id.description: ID of the authenticated user (from session context)

task_id.description: ID of the task to delete

success.description: Whether the task was deleted successfully

errors.message: I couldn't find a task matching that description. Your tasks are still intact.
You don't have permission to delete this task.
Failed to delete task. Please try again.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Updates the title and/or description of an existing todo task for the authenticated user

user_id.description: ID of the authenticated user (from session context)

task_id.description: ID of the task to update

title.description: New task title (optional, null to keep existing)

description.description: New task description (optional, null to keep existing, empty string to clear)

success.description: Whether the task was updated successfully

message.example: I've updated your task to 'buy groceries and milk'.

errors.message: At least one field (title or description) must be provided to update
Title must be between 1 and 200 characters
I couldn't find that task to update.
You don't have permission to modify this task.
Failed to update task. Please try again.

notes: All tools require authenticated user session
user_id is extracted from session context (not user-provided)
Tools validate task ownership: task.user_id must match session user_id
No cross-user data access permitted (SC-008 requirement)
Breakdown: Cohere API ~1500ms + MCP tools ~50ms + overhead ~1450ms
Database operations use indexed queries for fast lookups
